title: Which drive is visible? Phase readout and source localization
question: Under the R1 circuit, which source-channel combinations are identifiable from amplitude-only, single complex-channel and two coherent complex-channel observations, and how can readout error create a false receiver-drive residual?

incoming_evidence.accepted: Passive coupled loading closes the energy budget; receiver voltage gain alone does not locate the drive.
incoming_evidence.selected_objection: R1B calls for exact rival drives, inverse kernels and explicit complex-readout error bounds.

historical_lenses.Tesla: Keep both phase and readout/loading channels in the mechanism.

parameters.inherits: R1 nominal inductances, capacitances, R1,R2,RL20ohm, omega0

model.forward: I=Z^-1 e with the checked R1 nominal Z; both actual source port voltages are unknown for inference. Source knob values are not substituted for measured source voltages.
model.identifiability: Report domain dimension4 and real ranks/nullities. For nonlinear squared-amplitude maps distinguish local Jacobian kernels at the nonzero fixture from exact finite phase-rival families; zero-current boundary has rank0 for those squared maps.
model.exact_rivals: Full receiver complex current is unchanged by I→I+(delta,0), e→e+Z(delta,0). Both current magnitudes are unchanged by I→(I1,exp(i phi)I2), e→Z I'. Verify changed source vectors reproduce identical restricted observations.
model.coherent_reconstruction: ehat=Zhat Ihat; calibrated full complex map rank4. For secondary reconstruction with only M uncertain and |δIj|≤epsilon_j, bound |ehat2-e2| ≤ omega |Mhat| epsilon1 + |Zhat22| epsilon2 + omega ΔM (|Ihat1|+epsilon1). All other component parameters exact in this bounded model.
model.phase_artifact: Set true e2=0. Rotate only measured I2 by each frozen phase error and reconstruct ehat2. Compare exact artifact Z22 I2(exp(i phi)-1) with numerical inversion.
model.boundary: No cosmological field, stochastic detector noise, calibration drift, instrument transfer uncertainty beyond specified disk/M bounds, nonlinear material response or unmeasured additional port.

controls: Nominal two-current complex reconstruction returns injected source voltages
Explicit exact phase-rival and receiver-kernel examples
Analytical real Jacobians with ranks and kernel witnesses for all four maps; distinguish zero-current squared-amplitude rank0
128 boundary fixtures: 8 phases per independent current error times two M error endpoints; evaluate deterministic disk inclusion, no probabilistic coverage claim
Zero receiver drive with phase error creates a nonzero reconstructed receiver drive
Compare bounded disk exclusion of zero for nominal injected signal; unknown calibration means withhold unconditional signal claim

acceptance.positive_control: Nominal5mV fixture with stated bounds excludes zero; absence must be reported, not repaired by retuning parameters.

artifacts: CSV observations, rivals and uncertainty fixtures
falsifier: Failure to recover the stipulated effective drive under exact calibrated full readout rejects the implementation; a restricted observation with an exact rival cannot establish source identity.
limits: Effective source location is not physical source identity
Calibration bounds are supplied assumptions, not measured performance
Rank calculations are finite model properties; real instruments require calibrated transfer functions
No dark-matter search sensitivity or detection significance is calculated
next_round_rule: Choose R3 only after R2B. Candidate: add an environmental witness to test whether a residual receiver drive can be separated from ordinary pickup, and identify which witness/calibration assumptions are indispensable.
